question: Does the v8-selected, checkpoint-only rank-seven H3 reader basis retain behavioral sufficiency, complement selectivity, and L15H5/H1 transport on sealed v9?

authority.selection: Rank seven was the smallest v8 rank reaching 90% behavior/transport and at most 12% complement in both panels.
authority.v9_capability: 32/32 native base and donor correctness in both panels; no causal outcome observed before this registration.

frozen_design.basis: Recompute the exact rank-seven member of the already sealed family: frozen semantic rank two plus the first five orthogonal singular modes of the normalized H3-output-to-L15H5/H1 q/k/q2/k2/v checkpoint reader map.
frozen_design.population: All 64 jointly capable v9 A1/A2 rows.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: All hashes, capability, orthonormality, reconstruction, identity, decomposition, finite records, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_full_h3_is_material: Full H3 has correct direction on at least 90% and at least 30% of live-writer mean recovery in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_rank7_is_behaviorally_sufficient: Rank seven carries at least 90% of full-H3 mean behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_rank7_complement_is_selective: The exact orthogonal complement carries at most 12% absolute full-H3 mean behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_rank7_transports_to_l15_pair: Rank seven carries at least 90% of full-H3 L15H5/H1 response in both panels.

decision: Paired confirmation requires A-E. Failure is reported without rank adjustment on v9.
